description: Ratchet eval fixture: a block palette (lane MD-PAL). `sections` items carry a `kind` the server picks from the enum; `variants` names the item fields each kind fills, and the template renders each kind in its own branch (numbered list, task list, code block, blockquote). The model never picks the kind.

sections.role: one block of the page, of the kind the server chose

kind.role: block kind; the server picks it, copy it as given

items.role: steps kind: one numbered step each, in order; checklist kind: one task item each

command.role: one shell command, copied verbatim from a source, rendered in a code block

text.role: one verbatim line from a source, rendered as a blockquote
